body.focus: Fix two defects in the shipped VS Code scratchpads popup (ISSUE-3183af2a005db14f): (1) clicking "New scratchpad" in the chat status-bar popup must open the created scratchpad document — audit the scratch-new chain (vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-panel.ts:2531 webview post → vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts:792 SCRATCH_INTENT_TYPES intercept → vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-host.ts case 'scratch-new' (promptTitle → createScratch → refreshBrowse → openDocument) → vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts openDocument/openSingleton) so the insrc.scratchpad panel is reliably created/revealed after createScratch succeeds, and content delivery is not lost to the webview ready-handshake race (extension.ts postMessage swallow at :987-989, scratch-ready generation binding in scratch-panels.ts); (2) render the popup's "New scratchpad" and "Browse all" entries as icon-only rows (SVG icon + title/aria-label, consistent with the icon-only #insrc-scratch button at chat-panel.ts:2865-2867) at the top of the popup instead of text mitem rows at the bottom (chat-panel.ts:2528-2532). Update the chat-panel tests that pin the current text rows.
